name: Residence Permit for Study (E Category)

requirements.blocker_text: Official request/invitation from the inviting educational organization stating the area of study and duration of stay in Mongolia.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission and an invitation letter from a Mongolian educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Must apply for the residence permit at the Immigration Agency within 21 days of entering Mongolia.

evidence_required.document: Invitation/admission letter stating area and duration of study

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed in sources fetched; extension processed 5 (standard) or 3 (expedited) working days, fee 82,000 MNT for extension

sources.title: Immigration Agency of Mongolia -- E1 residence permit extension page: invitation letter must state area of study and duration of stay; extension must be filed 5 days before expiry; 82,000 MNT extension fee, 5-day standard/3-day expedited processing
